note: Besides 1.18, native 1.19 also documents the cell in edition 9020, spelled Value rather than VALUE. Delivered cells are keyed by the folded column, so 1.18 is not the cell's sole owner: a second source native is a positive authority, and the withdrawal belongs to contradictory_question. The carry itself is unchanged.
fails_if: `_carried_replacement_refusal` stops refusing a cell that another source native documents in the same edition, or compares that native's column by exact spelling, so member 1802 becomes support beside 1.19 and the carry

sources.description: scb-carried-replacement plus native 1.19 documenting the same column, spelled Value, in edition 9020 (version 2020).
